# truenas_group (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS local group by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean)
- `gid` (Number) UNIX GID.
- `id` (Number) Numeric group ID.
- `immutable` (Boolean)
- `local` (Boolean)
- `smb` (Boolean)
- `sudo_commands` (List of String)
- `sudo_commands_nopasswd` (List of String)
